hero.heading: Build and Kill Zombies
hero.lead: Build and Kill Zombies is a Roblox game where you roll CAR PARTS and SUPPORTS, bolt an engine, fuel tank, and wheels onto your car, then drive as far as you can while killing zombies to earn Cash and unlock permanent Skills.
hero.supportingText: This wiki keeps five focused pages: current codes, a parts and Skills tier list, the best car build, a beginner route, and boss timer prep. Pick where you are stuck.

sections.heading: Build and Kill Zombies Wiki: Quick Start
paragraphs: Every session in Build and Kill Zombies follows the same loop. You visit the CAR PARTS machine to roll Blocks, Engines, Wheels, and Fuels, attach them to your chassis in the build area, then roll the SUPPORTS machine for weapons and add-ons. Once the car can actually run, you drive it into zombie territory, kill zombies, and push your best distance for Studs.

Distance and kills pay Cash, and Cash funds your next rolls and upgrades. Alongside the car itself, your account earns Skills like Luck, which improve what the machines give you over time. That combination, a working car plus permanent account progression, is what turns short early runs into long profitable ones.
New players should start with the beginner guide, while anyone deciding what to buy next will get the most out of the tier list and best build pages below.

paragraphs: Not every roll or purchase deserves your Cash. The tier list ranks the game's real systems, Fuel, Engines, Wheels, Supports, and permanent Skills like Luck, by how much they improve your runs, so you stop spending on rolls that only look good.

sections.heading: How to Play Build and Kill Zombies
paragraphs: A first session is simple once someone orders it for you: finish the tutorial, roll your first CAR PARTS, get an engine with fuel and wheels onto a chassis, add one Support, then drive until the zombies win. That first drive pays Cash and Studs, which fund better rolls immediately after.
The beginner guide turns that loop into a ten-minute route, covering the machines, the build area, driving, and what to upgrade first so you do not waste your opening Cash.

sections.heading: CAR PARTS, SUPPORTS, Skills and Progression
sections.intro: Build and Kill Zombies splits progression across three systems. Knowing which is which keeps every purchase pointed at a stronger account.
bullets: CAR PARTS machine: rolls the physical pieces of your car, including Blocks, Engines, Wheels, and Fuels.
SUPPORTS machine: rolls weapons and add-ons that are separate from the car parts, giving the car ways to kill zombies.
Skills: permanent account progression such as Luck, More Support, and Gold Roll that improves what rolls give you over time.
Cash and Studs: the currencies your runs earn, spent on rolls, parts, and progression.
Fuel and Engine pairing: an engine only earns its price when the tank behind it can feed the distance you plan to drive.
paragraphs: The tier list page compares these systems against each other, and the best build page shows how they combine into one working car.

sections.heading: Build and Kill Zombies Boss Timer and Events
paragraphs: Boss fights run on a countdown: the HUD shows NEXT BOSS IN, a visible timer the game uses to signal the next boss encounter. Use the window to finish upgrades and test the build, and the boss guide turns that countdown into a preparation checklist.

faq.question: What is Build and Kill Zombies?
faq.answer: Build and Kill Zombies is a free Roblox game that mixes vehicle building with zombie survival. You roll parts from the CAR PARTS and SUPPORTS machines, build a working car, drive it as far as possible while killing zombies, and earn Cash and Studs to upgrade your build and Skills.

faq.question: Is the game free to play?
faq.answer: Yes, the game is free to play on Roblox on PC and mobile through the Roblox app. Codes and normal play provide the resources you need; spending is optional.

faq.question: What are the working Build and Kill Zombies codes?
faq.answer: Codes like ZEUS, COMMUNITY, and CashDrop were reported working as of the September 26, 2026 source check. The codes page keeps the full current list with rewards, redeem steps, and expired codes.

faq.question: What is the difference between CAR PARTS and SUPPORTS?
faq.answer: CAR PARTS rolls the pieces your car is physically built from, such as Blocks, Engines, Wheels, and Fuels. SUPPORTS rolls weapons and add-ons separately. A complete build needs both: parts so the car runs, supports so it kills.

faq.question: What do Skills do long-term?
faq.answer: Skills are permanent account progression. Luck improves what you get from rolls, More Support adds support capacity, and Gold Roll is a premium progression option. Unlike car parts, Skills are not lost when your car is rebuilt.

faq.question: What does NEXT BOSS IN mean?
faq.answer: NEXT BOSS IN is the countdown shown in the HUD before a boss fight arrives. It is your preparation window: roll, upgrade, and check the build before it reaches zero. The boss guide explains what to prioritize.
